package mattermost

import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/TwiN/gatus/v5/alerting/alert"
	"github.com/TwiN/gatus/v5/config/endpoint"
)

func TestCaptureFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	desc := "Homepage is unreachable"
	a := alert.Alert{Description: &desc, SuccessThreshold: 2, FailureThreshold: 3}
	p := AlertProvider{DefaultConfig: Config{WebhookURL: "http://sideporch.test/hooks/x", Channel: "alerts"}}
	ep := &endpoint.Endpoint{Name: "website", Group: "core"}
	failed := &endpoint.Result{ConditionResults: []*endpoint.ConditionResult{
		{Condition: "[STATUS] == 200", Success: false},
		{Condition: "[RESPONSE_TIME] < 500", Success: true},
	}}
	passed := &endpoint.Result{ConditionResults: []*endpoint.ConditionResult{
		{Condition: "[STATUS] == 200", Success: true},
		{Condition: "[RESPONSE_TIME] < 500", Success: true},
	}}
	write := func(name string, body []byte) {
		if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/gatus-fixtures/"+name, append(body, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	write("mattermost-triggered.json", p.buildRequestBody(&p.DefaultConfig, ep, &a, failed, false))
	write("mattermost-resolved.json", p.buildRequestBody(&p.DefaultConfig, ep, &a, passed, true))
	write("mattermost-no-conditions.json", p.buildRequestBody(&Config{Channel: "alerts"}, ep, &alert.Alert{FailureThreshold: 1}, &endpoint.Result{}, false))
}
